change: Gate each original box/keypoint scale with its original scores and the unchanged runtime threshold.

method.hardware: Intel Core i9-13980HX, Windows 11, CPUExecutionProvider; RTX 4060 unused by inference.

benchmark.micro_sampling: uniform across each whole video; sequential decode; interleaved videos
benchmark.inference: prepared CPU tensor to returned CPU outputs, including GPU transfers/synchronization
benchmark.capture_to_result: submission to result, including worker queue; excludes camera/driver
benchmark.scheduled_to_result: scheduled video PTS to result, including producer lateness
benchmark.excluded: preview/UI rendering, network, Re-ID, final image saving; models warm before replay
benchmark.startup: new model sessions in an existing Python process; OS file cache not flushed

method.runtime_held_constant: HighQoS, ORT 4 threads, 1000 us spin/backoff 8, OpenCV 1 thread in both groups.
method.source_order: User then Wolfhound in A; reversed in B. All inference jobs serial.
method.pooling: Concatenate individual frame timings, then compute percentiles; FPS=sum(processed)/sum(elapsed).
limitations: External system load and CPU frequency not locked; no worst-case latency guarantee.
Stage timers cover only frames where the stage ran; nested timings must not be added to total.
Two-video parity is not a broader accuracy evaluation.
Instrumented offline profiles and prepared-input microbenchmarks are not real-time throughput.

cli_smoke.note: Default auto QoS and 2 warmups. No selected photos; CLI source returns 2 for that normal result.
